editorial.blurb: Strings Ramen Shop serves authentic, carefully crafted ramen that lives up to years of loyal devotion, with a welcoming staff and cozy intimate setting.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive around 2 PM for shorter waits (though seating is limited with only about ten seats), and if you're new to their Hell Ramen challenge, start at level 2 to gauge your spice tolerance before advancing.
